A six-month extension is available if requested prior to the due date and the estimated correct amount of tax is paid before the due date. The gift tax return is due on April 15 following the year in which the gift is made. For other forms in the Form 706 series, and for Forms 8892 and 8855, see the related instructions for due date information. Where to file To pay estate and gift tax online, use the secure and convenient Electronic Federal Tax Payment System . If you are using a private delivery service to file your return, use the Submission Processing Center street address .
